title: Prepare the nominal thermal encoding with an explicit finite-bit contract
statement: At beta=ln B, choose independent supplied-check Bernoulli1/(B+1) bits and reject unless the vector lies in the known valid syndrome subspace. The accepted law is exactly proportional to B^(-|sigma|), with expected proposals<=exp(m/B). Applying the same decoder correction backwards to a ground-code isometry produces Enc0(omega). A declared cap gives flagged failure<=2^-ell or an always-return channel with diamond debit<=2^(1-ell).

requires: Accepted source-qualified even RX/RZ family and nominal H0=sum(I-S_j)/2, exact shared corrected logical algebra, fixed geometry/incidence and beta>beta_c
One preselected nominal finite-frequency heat-bath controller/encoder/decoder and actual isolated logical/reference input at the stated ideal initialization boundary
provides: Accepted computationally explicit nominal encoder selected before unknown neutral errors
assumptions: One common correction rule and exact rational coins required; redundant-check constraints stay in the sampler
This is not efficient-in-n at fixed B and not a native Gibbs-state oracle
Sampling may finish before the unknown payload arrives; a flagged failure need not consume it
Errors acting during actual preparation need separate fault-tolerant control/debit
Slow full Gibbs mixing neither proves nor rules out better syndrome-only initialization
costs: Jstar=2 nu v0+6+2 J_e, support Q and3n per-seed controller budget; energy H0/dephasing defects vanish exactly
Exact nominal syndrome sampler at beta=ln B has expected proposals<=(1+1/B)^m<=exp(m/B); no efficient-in-n promise
Qualified preparation/control/routing/holding/reset/readout, physical rates and full noisy-preparation debit remain additional
contract.units: Exact rational syndrome probabilities, expected proposal/fair-bit costs, flagged failure and full-channel diamond initialization allowance.
contract.obstruction: An explicit mathematical initializer still has real sampling, location, Clifford and noisy-control costs.

evidence.quote: # A nominal thermal encoder without a free Gibbs-state oracle
evidence.range_scope: Actual received exact-version governing statement or completed scoped internal review; no new scientific audit.

body: Actual stationary state is rho0=Gibbs(H0), generally NOT Gibbs(H0+V). Unknown Hermitian V must satisfy[H0,V]=0; it may fail individual-check commutation. Dissipative errors must be the declared balanced class, not all weak Lindblad errors. Arbitrary energy-changing errors, native physical controller/bath, useful thresholds, efficient/noisy initialization and advantage remain open. The ordinary Bravyi-Terhal trace receiver and nominal Davies/virtual-subsystem construction are credited. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Acquired substantive root whole-chain analytic acceptance of exact-source fixed-controller, preparation and scoped obstruction. No external review, physical evidence or priority clearance inferred.
